observation.command:
echo "This is a validation test of the open_taki text extraction pipeline with some more content to make it longer than twenty characters." > /tmp/test.txt && echo "From: test@example.com
Subject: Test Email

Hello, this is an email body." > /tmp/test.eml && curl -sS -X PUT --data-binary @/tmp/test.txt -H "Content-Type: text/plain" http://localhost:9998/rmeta/text -w "
HTTP_CODE:%{http_code}
" && echo "=== EMAIL TEST ===" && printf 'From: test@example.com
Subject: Test Email

Hello, this is an email body.
' > /tmp/test2.eml && curl -sS -X PUT --data-binary @/tmp/test2.eml -H "Content-Type: message/rfc822" http://localhost:9998/rmeta/text -w "
HTTP_CODE:%{http_code}
"
